subject: Film & Cinema
title: Genre Mashups: Breaking Boundaries
description: A quick, practical guide to Genre Mashups: Breaking Boundaries.

hook.text: Parasite won Best Picture by being a comedy, thriller, horror film, and drama all at once.

buildup.text: Genre mashups combine elements from multiple genres to create something unexpected.

discovery.text: Blending genres keeps audiences off-balance — they can't predict what comes next.

twist.text: Studios often resist mashups because they're harder to market with a single trailer.

climax.text: The most original films of the last decade defy genre classification entirely.

punchline.text: The best films ignore the genre menu.

quiz.question: Why do studios sometimes resist genre mashup films?
options: They're harder to market to a specific audience
